Fitbit MCP Unofficial

Unofficial local-first MCP server for connecting AI agents to Fitbit data through the user-authorized Google Health API.

Default scopes: read-only Google Health activity, health metrics, profile, settings, sleep and nutrition.
Important tools: fitbit_connection_status, fitbit_daily_summary, fitbit_weekly_summary, fitbit_get_sleep_day, fitbit_get_heart_day, fitbit_get_hrv_day, fitbit_get_heart_intraday.
Privacy: tokens stay local under ~/.fitbit-mcp. summary and structured modes minimize sensitive output. raw mode is explicit.
Boundary: not affiliated with Fitbit or Google. Not medical advice. Does not expose raw device telemetry.
